map.算法：阳性阈值 DOB ≥ 4.0（¹³C 单位 ‰、¹⁴C 单位 DPM）。<: Algorithm: positive threshold DOB of 4.0 or above (per mille for 13C, DPM for 14C). Below 2.0 is negative; 2.0~4.0 is a gray or borderline zone (combine with other methods or retest); 4.0 or above is positive. If PPIs were used before the test...
map.感染判读：由 ¹³C/¹⁴C 尿素呼气试验 DOB 值按阈值判阴/阳性: Infection reading: judge negative or positive by the DOB threshold from the 13C or 14C urea breath test
map.假阴性排查：近 2 周 PPI、4 周抗生素/铋剂可致假阴性: False negative check: PPIs within the last 2 weeks, or antibiotics or bismuth within the last 4 weeks, can cause a false negative
map.复查时机：根除后 ≥4 周复查确认是否成功: Retest timing: retest at least 4 weeks after eradication to confirm success
map.应以本中心试剂说明书为准: Follow the reagent instructions of your own center
map.¹³C 和 ¹⁴C 阈值一样吗？: Are the 13C and 14C thresholds the same?
map.临床判读阈值都常用 DOB ≥ 4.0，但单位不同（¹³C 为 ‰、¹⁴C 为: Clinical interpretation commonly uses a DOB threshold of 4.0 or above, but the units differ (per mille for 13C, DPM for 14C), and thresholds differ slightly between reagent makers (some 14C use 100 DPM or above). Follow the reagent instructions of your own center.
map.为什么 PPI 会让结果假阴性？: Why do PPIs cause a false negative?
map.PPI 抑制胃酸分泌、改变胃内微环境，可暂时降低幽门螺杆菌尿素酶活性与细菌负荷，: PPIs suppress gastric acid secretion and change the gastric microenvironment, which can temporarily reduce H. pylori urease activity and bacterial load, lowering the DOB value and causing a false negative. Therefore stop PPIs for at least 2 weeks before testing, and antibiotics and bismuth for at least 4 weeks.
